description: The ultimate Minecraft mod that visualises statistics in a cool way.

mods.name: Statify
mods.description: This mod gets all the stats of the player in the current world and uploads it into Google Sheets.

releases.notes:
## Introducing: Statify 1.1.0 #### This update focuses on User Experience and QOL functionalities.
  1. Added a GUI for /get-coords to make viewing saved coordinates much more intuitive.
    • Added the main "Saved Coordinates" GUI panel.
    • Added a dimension filter button.
    • Made saved coordinates editable.
  2. Added the /save-coords-here command, allowing you to instantly save your current position and dimension.
  3. Redesigned the /help command with a brand-new GUI.
  4. Added Last Session tracking.
    • Saves your stats upon leaving a world (blocks broken, mobs killed, and days survived).
    • Displays a session summary whenever you rejoin the world.
  5. And last but not least: MILESTONES
    • Unlock milestones by breaking blocks, defeating mobs, and surviving days.
Required Fabric versions
[Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api/version/0.156.0+26.2) `0.156.0+26.2`
[Fabric Loader](https://github.com/FabricMC/fabric-loader/releases/tag/0.19.3) `>=0.19.3`
#### If you have any questions, concerns or have explored a bug, please open an [issue ticket](https://github.com/Soviaat/Statify/issues/new).
